rv.q: But as a whole the work is lacking traction and effective dramaturgy.
In its strongest moments, Altunaga draws on Afro-Cuban dance stylings and the imposing power of ritual is glimpsed in full-bodied dance, powered by thundering percussion.

cn.t: Phoenix Dance Theatre's triple bill earns praise for its bold artistic vision under new director Marcus Jarrell Willis, with critics applauding the company's compelling exploration of human experiences through poignant and tender choreography.
